categories.definition: Internet service provider, internet signal provider, internet equipment, solar equipment related to internet, cell/phone fees and service recharge, phone number, domain name renewal, website software for domains, social media management, consultation, programming, app development, internet cafe time, etc.

Treating others to meals, outings, events, etc. for relationship building, recruitment, project discussion, or developing understanding of the mission and how needs can be met; may include oneself, others, and tips.
Machinery used to repair, fabricate, build, or construct something else related to Camps International purposes; usually not office related.

Architectural plans/consulting, excavation, materials, labor, building, signage, flags, landscaping, maintenance, and repair related to the camp site, camp development, events, or other Camps International purposes; includes solar equipment related to facility.
Bank, legal, passport, visa, and similar often-unavoidable prerequisite expenses needed to do business or move projects forward.
Acts of generosity or compassion related to need, conscience, or humanitarianism; documentation may be enhanced through photos or event/publication evidence; includes donations to other ministries.
Stipend, offering of gratitude, financial thank-you, or similar compensation for contribution to Camps International purposes beyond a volunteer.

Expenses related to hosting others; thank-you gifts for staying at someone's home while doing Camps International work; and overnight lodging while traveling, with receipt required for accommodations.
Office equipment, furniture, supplies, postage, delivery, and study/teaching materials; may include solar equipment.
Meals related to travel significantly far from home base; first and last day rates differ from full day rates; location is Other.
Brochures, promotion, tracts, manuals, and books.
categories.mappingNote: The supplied workbook contains a Publishing export label but the supplied policy defines Printing. Do not equate them without Camps International confirmation.

categories.definition: Materials and supplies used to build or equip an activity, event, or program so objectives are better met, themes reinforced, or practitioners are facilitated to perform skill-based, experiential, or other activities benefiting campers and participants in realms related to core values; may include solar equipment.
Documentation of transactions used as proof in other accounting where no expense is claimed, such as ATM withdrawals, currency exchange, or photos of documents.

Transportation to and from transport hubs, hosts, camp sites, training locations, churches, stores, and similar destinations to perform Camps International work; may include parking, tolls, mileage, taxi, public transport, and borrowed or rented cars.

templateOnlyLabels.note: Observed in workbook; no independently matching category definition appears in the supplied policy sheet.
